Chapter 125: Heard You're Dating?

After the parent-teacher conference, No. 1 Affiliated High School returned to its normal academic rhythm.

However, after the lashings of the midterm exams, many students became even more serious.

Because he had placed first in the class, many of his classmates even started coming to Li Luo to ask for help with some questions.

Fortunately, his actual skill level was already quite good, and he could command various knowledge points with ease, so he could handle it.

Moreover, this method of helping others answer questions was, in itself, a way to consolidate his own knowledge framework.

Those who frequently explained problems to their classmates were often the ones with the clearest and most flexible grasp of the knowledge points.

To learn and review from time to time; to gain new knowledge by re-examining the old.

In Western terms, it's also called the Feynman learning technique.

Only when you can break down a problem, mash it up, and make a struggling student completely understand the problem-solving process does it prove that you have truly and thoroughly mastered the entire knowledge system and framework behind it.

That was why Li Luo had recently taken a liking to the process of explaining problems to Yan Zhusheng.

He found that this method not only improved his own understanding and problem-solving skills in science subjects like math, physics, and chemistry, but it was also quite fulfilling.

It was just like playing a puzzle game.

The moment the puzzle was solved, he felt immense pleasure in both body and mind, becoming more and more addicted the more he did it.

It just so happened that Yan Zhusheng wasn't very good at science, so Li Luo often gave her private tutoring sessions.

And when it came time for evening club activities, the two of them would go to the rock club to continue their practice.

If she finished her homework early that day, Yan Zhusheng would go pitter-patter to the second-year academic building, find Niu Qingling to get the key to the activity room, then pull Li Luo along, and the two would sneak into the rock club.

Yan Zhusheng would act as the music teacher, giving Li Luo a private lesson.

When the second evening self-study session was about to end, they would go for a run on the athletic field and listen to some music.

Later, Niu Qingling found it too troublesome and simply gave the activity room key directly to Yan Zhusheng for safekeeping.

Now, sometimes when they had free time during lunch, Yan Zhusheng would call Li Luo over, and the two would run to the activity room to practice.

Of course, such times were not very common.

Because sometimes Ying Chanxi would come to the classroom looking for Li Luo, holding a video camera, and drag him to the athletic field to record an MV.

As a result, Zhu Yufei often complained that the class president was elusive; whenever they were short a person on the basketball court, they could never find the guy.

He had no idea where he had run off to fool around.

He'd been in the basketball club for almost two months but had rarely been seen at any club activities.

As for the literature club, Li Luo, relying on his status as vice president, had been responsible for chasing down a batch of submissions at the end of October, but he himself hadn't written a single thing.

Almost all of his creative desire was dedicated to his dear online novel readers.

And during a literature club activity after collecting the submissions, Li Luo even received pen pal letters from several girls from other classes.

It once made Ying Chanxi, who was next to him, squint at him, smiling as she said, "Student Li Luo, you've really made it now, getting more and more popular."

"I basically never participate in the literature club's regular activities." Li Luo looked at the few letters in his hand with a strange expression, then compared them with Ying Chanxi's next to him. "But you still have more, at least twice as many as me."

"Hmph." Ying Chanxi gathered the letters on the desk and stuffed them into her school bag. "Don't you know? You're really famous in the other classes now."

"How so?"

"I'm not too sure either." Ying Chanxi shook her head. "Xinyan told me about it when we were eating."

"She said that even in our Class One, some girls are discussing you."

"Many people in other classes also know that the class president of Class Eight scored 27th in the whole school, the only prodigy from a parallel class who can hold his own against the monsters of Class One."

"That's true," Li Luo said with a nod. "I've never been afraid of anyone in an arm wrestle. I could even give you a one-hand handicap."

"You're just talking nonsense." Ying Chanxi rolled her eyes at him, then her gaze fell curiously on Li Luo's letters. Her heart itched, really wanting to know what was written inside.

But she knew her limits and wouldn't actually read them, so she could only wonder about it.

And Li Luo, just like her, casually stuffed these letters into his school bag without paying them much attention.

However, Li Luo felt a little different at that moment. He never thought that one day he would attract girls' attention with his academic performance.

What a novel experience.

Under this rhythm of school life, October passed uneventfully.

In early November, at the student council's weekly regular meeting.

Xu Youyu sat in the head seat, holding a document, and asked Vice President Ying Chanxi to help distribute materials related to the sports meet arrangements.

Li Luo and Shi Yanran sat in the seats for Class Eight, right next to Gao Yuqin, the class president of Class Seven.

While the materials were being handed out, Gao Yuqin quietly leaned toward Li Luo's ear and asked in a low, gossipy voice, "Li Luo, I heard you're dating?"

Taking the documents from the student in front of him, Li Luo shot a surprised glance at Gao Yuqin, then frowned and said, "Where did you hear that rumor."

"A classmate from your class said so." Gao Yuqin blinked. "A lot of people are talking about it in the girls' dorms, saying you're dating that girl named Yan Zhusheng."

"...You guys really have too much time on your hands." Li Luo looked speechless. "How do we look like we're dating? We just have a simple deskmate relationship."

"But Lu Wei told me last time that you'd already chosen Yan Zhusheng." Gao Yuqin said, "I didn't quite believe it at first, but now that the girls in your class are all saying it, I have to believe it."

"They say you two often eat lunch together and go off somewhere together. You even often disappear together during evening self-study."

"You two are really bold. Aren't you afraid of getting caught by the teachers?"

Li Luo's mouth twitched. "Don't let your imagination run wild. We just go to the rock club's activity room to practice."

As he spoke, he waved the document in his hand. "The sports meet is coming up. Both she and I have to perform on stage. We don't have the spare time to think about other things."

"Eh? So you mean, you're not dating right now?" Gao Yuqin raised her eyebrows, her eyes becoming playful.

But Li Luo just chuckled. "Student Gao Yuqin, I think you'd be better off focusing on your studies."

"If I really wanted to find a girlfriend, it probably wouldn't be you."

"Let's just focus on the meeting for now."

It had to be said, girls could be strange creatures sometimes.

Lu Wei from Class Seven was quite handsome and was also very attentive to Gao Yuqin, even climbing over the school wall just to buy her a cup of milk tea.

But the more readily available something was, the less interested Gao Yuqin became.

Instead, after repeatedly hitting a wall with Li Luo, she was first unhappy, but was then spurred on with great fighting spirit, trying to flirt with Li Luo from time to time.

After being rejected, she became even more persistent. It was a real headache.

"This year's sports meet is preliminarily scheduled for the 13th to the 15th of this month, which is next Thursday, Friday, and Saturday morning."

Seeing that the materials had been distributed to everyone, Xu Youyu began to speak. "Let's go over the related tasks for the next two weeks."

"First, the sports meet registration forms will be handed out to everyone later. When you get back, pass them to your class's sports representative. The registration must be completed by this Thursday."

"Second, we student council members should decide which events we will sign up for as soon as possible."

"Then, based on everyone's participation, we will assign you to be responsible for some of the tasks at the sports meet."

"This includes hosting, maintaining order, guiding the athletes, and so on."

"Third, for the opening ceremony of the sports meet, each class will enter from the track in front of the rostrum. You'll need a slogan and introduction that includes your class's unique characteristics. This needs to be submitted by the end of this week."

"Fourth..."

At the front, Xu Youyu methodically laid out the various matters concerning the sports meet.

Although Gao Yuqin next to him was a bit odd when it came to romance, she was a competent class president and was diligently taking notes.

With his memory palace, Li Luo wasn't in a hurry. He just held a pen and pretended to be writing.

After the meeting ended, he stretched his back and had Shi Yanran go to the front to collect the sports meet registration forms and other things, then prepared to head back to the classroom.

Just then, Ying Chanxi walked up to him, looking at him with great suspicion as she asked, "That class president from Class Seven next to you, what was she whispering to you about just now?"

Li Luo glanced at Ying Chanxi and answered truthfully, "She said I've been spending a lot of time with a certain girl recently and asked if I was dating."

"Ah?" Ying Chanxi was stunned for a moment, then she remembered that she had been looking for Li Luo frequently recently, dragging him all over the school to record the MV, which had indeed attracted a lot of attention.

She didn't think it would spread like this?

At this thought, Ying Chanxi's face immediately flushed red. "You, you didn't say anything reckless, did you?"

"Of course not," Li Luo said. "I'm studying hard and making progress every day, striving to be an outstanding youth representative of No. 1 Affiliated High School. How could I possibly get into an early romance?"

Hearing Li Luo's jesting, Ying Chanxi let out a quiet sigh of relief and laughingly hit his shoulder in annoyance.

But as she walked out of the classroom, for some reason, she felt a strange, small sense of disappointment in her heart.

(End of this chapter)
